title: Three federation policy fixture fences remain queued past five seconds without a reproduced cause
outcome: Determine and repair or explicitly resolve the observed fixture writer-queue deadline misses without blind retries, deadline inflation or weakening durable-content checks; preserve the original failing run and distinguish later non-reproduction from diagnosis.
acceptance: The three failures in test-e9251cd8-b4af-4617-a7db-db7652625dc9 are investigated with phase-specific evidence that identifies the cause or establishes an explicit bounded unresolved disposition accepted by the coordinator; later passing tests alone are not diagnosis.

A focused discriminating regression reproduces the identified cause and validates its repair while preserving the existing five-second durability budget and exact content/readback checks, or an independently concurred environment/runner resolution documents what changed and why.
The original failure, diagnostic timing data, relevant source identities and final findings remain recorded with durable evidence; the parent readiness exception does not silently close this defect.
